summary: An explicit replay-safe=false always forbids ambiguous retries, and only a per-request Idempotency-Key (never a static config header) makes a POST/PATCH replayable.
reason: Pin Generator does not honour Idempotency-Key, so a static key let a paid tools/call be resubmitted after a 5xx and charge more than once; reads and per-request-keyed writes keep their retries.
validated_outcome: TestReplayOptOutAndStaticKeyNeverResendPaidCalls and TestPaidCallNotResentWithStaticIdempotencyKey: exactly 1 paid attempt after 503 (4 before the fix); TestGenuineRetriesStillWork: GET and per-request-keyed POST still retry.
